item.title: National Assembly Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee Pushes for Football Association Hearing… Mention of Hong Myung-bo and Chung Mong-gyu's Appearance (국회 문체위, 축구협회 청문회 추진…홍명보·정몽규 출석 거론)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee is expected to push for a hearing regarding the Korea Football Association. Following the disappointing performance of the South Korean men's national football team, which was eliminated in the group stage qualifying for the 2026 North and Central America World Cup, the aim is to summon Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu and former national team head coach Hong Myung-bo as witnesses to examine the overall management of the association, including the process of selecting the head coach. (국회 문화체육관광위원회가 대한축구협회에 대한 청문회를 추진할 것으로 보인다. 한국 남자 축구국가대표팀이 2026 북중미 월드컵 조별예선에서 탈락하는 부진한 성적을 거둔 상황에서, 정몽규 대한축구협회장과 홍명보 전 국가대표팀 감독을 증인으로 불러 감독 선임 과정을 비롯한 협회 운영 전반을 살피겠다는 취지다.)

A Democratic Party of Korea official from the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee told *The Hankyoreh* on the 2nd, "As this is a matter of public concern, there is significant weight behind holding a hearing (regarding the Korea Football Association)." He added, "We plan to hold in-depth discussions on specific schedules, methods, and content at the party's workshop tomorrow (the 3rd)." (문체위 소속 더불어민주당 관계자는 2일 한겨레에 “국민적 관심 사안이다 보니 (대한축구협회에 대한) 청문회를 여는 데에 무게가 실려 있다”며 “구체적인 일정과 방안, 내용 등에 대해서는 내일(3일) 당 의원 워크숍에서 심도 있는 논의를 할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

If the hearing is held, it is expected to broadly cover the selection processes of former national team head coach Jürgen Klinsmann and former head coach Hong, as well as suspicions of opaque management within the association. (청문회가 열리면 위르겐 클린스만 전 대표팀 감독과 홍 전 감독의 선임 과정, 협회의 밀실 운영 의혹 등이 전반적으로 다뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

According to the results of an audit by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the appointment of then-head coach Klinsmann in February 2023 took place while the Korea Football Association's National Team Strength Enhancement Committee, which should have led the discussions, had been rendered ineffective. It was also confirmed that when former head coach Hong was appointed, then-KFA Technical Director Lee Im-saeng—who had no authority under the regulations to recommend a head coach—suggested a candidate, and the interview process was conducted opaquely. (문화체육관광부 감사 결과에 따르면, 2023년 2월 클린스만 당시 감독 선임은 해당 논의를 이끌어야 할 축구협회 산하 국가대표전력강화위원회 기능이 무력화한 가운데 이뤄졌다. 홍 전 감독이 선임될 때도 규정상 감독 선임 권한이 없는 이임생 당시 축구협회 기술총괄이사가 감독 후보를 추천하고, 면접도 불투명하게 이뤄진 것으로 확인됐다.)

However, as the People Power Party is boycotting National Assembly agenda items in protest of the Democratic Party-led formation of standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, further consultations between the ruling and opposition parties are likely needed before the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee is formed and an actual hearing can be held. (다만 국민의힘이 민주당 주도로 이뤄진 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 구성에 반발하며 국회 의사일정에 응하고 있지 않고 있어, 문체위가 구성되고 실제 청문회를 열기까지는 여야 간 협의가 더 이뤄져야 할 것으로 보인다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Stop the slander... Jung Cheong-rae in Honam, Kim Min-seok in Chungcheong 'tilling the electoral ground' (비방전 멈추고…정청래 호남, 김민석 충청 ‘표밭갈이’)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, former lawmaker and key contender in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention for party leadership, along with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, visited Honam and Chungcheong respectively on the 2nd. This came a day after President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in held a lunch meeting at the presidential office, temporarily halting mutual attacks to focus on 'tilling the electoral ground.' (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 유력 주자인 정청래 전 대표와 김민석 전 국무총리가 2일 각각 호남과 충청을 찾았다. 전날 이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령의 청와대 오찬 회동 뒤 상호 비방을 잠시 멈춘 채 ‘표밭’ 갈이에 나선 것이다.)

Former lawmaker Jung continued his focused campaign in Honam by visiting the May Mothers' House in Gwangju on this day. He wrote on Facebook, "I visited the May Mothers' House, where the May Mothers, who carry the pain of the May 18 Gwangju Uprising in their entire being, reside," adding, "In the spirit of inheriting the legacy of the May martyrs, I will further accelerate efforts to include the May 18 spirit in the preamble of the Constitution." (정 전 대표는 이날 광주 오월어머니집을 찾으며 호남 집중 행보를 이어갔다. 그는 페이스북에 “광주 5·18의 아픔을 온몸으로 간직하고 있는 오월어머니들이 계신 오월어머니집을 방문했다”며 “5월 영령들의 정신을 계승하는 차원에서 5·18 헌법 전문 수록에 더욱 박차를 가하겠다”고 썼다.)

Former lawmaker Jung has been maintaining a concentrated visit schedule in the Honam region, including attending the inauguration ceremony of Jeollabuk-do Governor Lee Won-taek and visiting traditional markets in North Jeolla Province the previous day. Despite criticism over his extended term as leader emerging during a breakfast meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers from the Gwangju constituency on July 26, he appears to be focusing on managing the sentiment of party members with voting rights, setting aside this negative atmosphere. Honam is home to over 30% of the Democratic Party's eligible voter members. (정 전 대표는 전날에는 이원택 전북도지사 취임식과 전북 지역 전통시장을 방문하는 등 호남권 집중 방문 행보를 이어가고 있다. 지난달 26일 광주 지역구 민주당 의원들의 조찬 회동에서 정 전 대표의 대표직 연임에 대한 비판이 나왔지만, 이런 부정적 기류를 뒤로하고 권리당원 표심 관리에 집중하는 모습이다. 호남은 민주당 권리당원 30% 이상이 밀집한 곳이다.)

On his second day back in the party, former Prime Minister Kim visited the Yukgeori General Market in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, followed by a visit to the SK Hynix plant in Cheongju. He highlighted the 'one team' concept with President Lee Jae-myung, who chaired the 'National Report on the Vision for Advanced Industry Development in the Chungcheong Region' in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, on the same day. Former Prime Minister Kim stated, "Today's schedule was set with the aspect of making it clear that supporting state tasks related to the realization of mega-projects is the biggest task for the Democratic Party as the ruling party." Meanwhile, Song Young-gil, another contender for party leadership, had planned to attend an event for alumni of his alma mater, Yonsei University, but spent the day without any official schedule after the event was canceled. (당 복귀 이틀째인 김 전 총리는 충북 청주 육거리종합시장을 찾은 뒤 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 청주 공장을 방문했다. 이날 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’를 충남 아산에서 주재한 이재명 대통령과 ‘원팀’ 콘셉트를 부각한 것이다. 김 전 총리는 “오늘 일정은 메가프로젝트 실현과 관련한 국정과제를 뒷받침하는 것이 집권당인 민주당의 최대 과제라는 것을 명확하게 하기 위해서 잡은 면이 있다”고 말했다. 또 다른 당권 주자인 송영길 의원은 모교인 연세대 동문 행사에 참석할 예정이었으나 행사가 취소되면서 공식 일정 없는 하루를 보냈다.)

Within the party, there are expectations that conflicts arising from the overheated convention will temporarily subside following the 'unity-oriented' lunch meeting between President Lee and former President Moon the previous day. Former lawmaker Jung, former Prime Minister Kim, and lawmaker Song refrained from slandering or attacking each other on this day. (당내에서는 전대 과열로 인한 갈등이 전날 이 대통령과 문 전 대통령의 ‘통합’ 오찬 회동으로 당분간은 잠잠할 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 정 전 대표와 김 전 총리, 송 의원은 이날 서로에 대한 비방이나 공격을 하지 않았다.)

Lawmaker Kim Nam-kuk said on KBS Radio, "Seeing the two (current and former presidents), many people will realize that we need to move toward unity, and that party members who amplify conflicts and use derogatory terms while attacking each other are the problem," adding, "I think yesterday's meeting itself served as a message, and it may lead to a direction of easing conflicts going forward." A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Even if it only leads to a temporary easing of conflicts, the two presidents (Lee Jae-myung and Moon Jae-in) putting out a message of unity likely sent a significant signal to the candidates and party members." (김남국 의원은 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 “(전현직 대통령) 두 분의 모습을 보고 많은 분들께서 역시 통합으로 가야 된다, 갈등을 증폭시키고 서로 멸칭 표현을 쓰고 공격하는 당원들이 문제라는 인식을 가질 것”이라며 “어제 만남 자체가 메시지가 되어 향후 갈등을 완화하는 방향으로 가지 않을까 싶다”고 말했다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “일시적인 갈등 완화에 그치더라도 두 대통령(이재명·문재인)이 통합의 메시지를 낸 것이 주자들과 당원들에게 작지 않은 메시지가 됐을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Despite Claims of 12 Votes, Only 1 in Reality…NEC Confirms 3 More Cases of ‘Incorrect Vote Entry’ (12표 받았다더니 실제론 1표…선관위 ‘득표수 오기입’ 3건 더 확인)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) has discovered three additional instances of incorrect vote tally entries during the June 3 local elections. In the elections for council members in Siheung, Gyeonggi, and Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang, valid and invalid votes were swapped. In the proportional representation election for the Gyeonggi Provincial Council, a party that actually received only one vote at one polling station was entered as receiving 12 votes, sparking a series of erroneous entries. <<> According to data submitted by the NEC on the 2nd to Rep. Choi Bo-yoon of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the June 3 Local Election Ballot Shortage, a full investigation of the vote tally system input revealed three additional cases of incorrect entries. <<> At the third polling station in Shinheun-dong, Siheung’s multi-member district, invalid and valid votes were swapped during a recount. Candidate Ahn Don of the People Power Party was initially recorded as receiving 91 votes but actually received 92 votes. One valid vote for Ahn had been mistakenly entered as invalid. At the second polling station in Yeonseong-dong, candidate Kim Jin-young of the Democratic Party of Korea was recorded as receiving 528 votes but actually received 529 votes. <<> At the Daegok-dong polling station in Gimcheon’s first district, independent candidate Lee Bok-sang was recorded as receiving 812 votes, and independent candidate Park Geon-woo as 767 votes. However, the full investigation showed they received 811 and 766 votes, respectively—one vote fewer each. Two invalid votes had been entered as valid. <<> In the proportional representation election for Gyeonggi Provincial Council, party vote counts were incorrectly entered at multiple stations in Suwon and Ansan’s Danwon-gu, etc. At the fourth polling station in Uman 1-dong, Paldal-gu, Suwon, the New Future Democratic Party, entered as having 12 votes, actually received 1 vote. Liberty and Innovation, entered as 7 votes, had 12 votes, and the Justice Party, entered as 2 votes, actually received 7 votes. <<> At the third polling station in Wa-dong, Danwon-gu, Ansan, the National Alliance, entered as receiving 3 votes, actually got 0 votes. The Christian Party, entered as 0 votes, had 3 votes; the New Future Democratic Party, entered as 11 votes, actually got 3 votes; Liberty and Innovation, entered as 6 votes, had 11 votes; and the Justice Party, entered as receiving 0 votes, actually received 6 votes. <<> The NEC explained, “With many party entry fields, there was confusion, such as shifting entry fields for some parties’ vote counts, leading to the incorrect entries,” adding, “The system will be corrected once appeals for the affected elections are concluded.” <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거에서 개표 결과를 잘못 입력한 사례를 3건 더 발견한 것으로 확인됐다. 경기 시흥시의원과 경북 김천시의원 선거에서는 유효표와 무효표가 뒤바뀌었고, 경기도의회 비례대표 의원 선거에선 한 투표소에서 실제 1표밖에 얻지 못한 정당이 12표를 얻었다고 입력되는 등 ‘무더기 오기입’ 사태가 벌어졌다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Concerns over Side Effects of Complete Abolition of Complementary Investigation Authority Voiced in Democratic Party Lawmakers' Chat Room ([단독] 민주 의원 대화방서 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지 부작용’ 우려 목소리)
item.description:
It has been confirmed that, in a group social media chat room for Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers, some lawmakers expressed concerns about the potential side effects of completely abolishing the prosecution's complementary investigation authority, calling for careful deliberation. It was also reported that arguments were made to retain the authority in exceptional circumstances. (더불어민주당 의원들의 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 단체 대화방에서 일부 의원들이 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전 폐지할 경우에 따른 부작용을 우려하며 숙의가 필요하다는 의견을 낸 것으로 것으로 확인됐다. 예외적 상황에서는 보완수사권을 남겨두자는 주장도 나왔다고 한다.)

According to multiple Democratic Party lawmakers on the 2nd, 4 to 5 lawmakers recently voiced concerns about the complete abolition of the complementary investigation authority in the group chat. One first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area stated, "I propose we look forward to discussion," and suggested, "Conditionally recognize the complementary investigation authority only for cases where the police have filed charges with an opinion to indict, and for other cases, only recognize the request for supplementary investigation, but even that should not be granted if it amounts to a separate investigation." He added, "The purpose of exceptionally allowing the prosecution's complementary investigation is to check the police's excessive investigations and to supplement rushed, poor investigations." (2일 여러 명의 민주당 의원에 따르면 최근 민주당 의원들 단체 대화방에서 의원 4∼5명이 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 우려하는 의견을 밝혔다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 “논의를 기대하는 제안을 한다”며 “경찰이 ‘기소의견 송치’한 사건에 한해 조건부로 보완수사권을 인정하고, 그 외는 보완수사요구권만 인정하되 별건 수사에 해당하는 경우는 보완수사요구권도 주지 말아야 한다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “검찰의 보완수사를 예외적으로 허용하는 건 경찰의 무리한 수사를 견제하고 시간에 쫓긴 부실 수사를 보완하자는 취지”라고 덧붙였다.)

In response, a multi-term lawmaker with a legal background added, "We need to discuss what to do when evidence is being destroyed, or there is a high risk of evidence destruction, or when the statute of limitations is about to expire, or when there is a serious human rights violation by the police in charge of the investigation (if complementary investigation is abolished)." (이에 법조계 출신 다선 의원은 “증거인멸이 진행되고 있거나 증거인멸의 위험성이 높은 상황이나 공소시효 만료가 임박한 경우, 수사를 담당한 경찰의 중대한 인권침해가 있는 경우 (보완수사를 폐지했을 때) 어떻게 할 것인지 논의를 해봐야 한다”는 의견을 더했다.)

A second-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area, who reportedly argued that deliberation on the complementary investigation authority is necessary, expressed concern in a phone call with The Hankyoreh on the same day, saying, "If we completely abolish the complementary investigation authority, it will be difficult to fully prevent harm to the people, no matter what compensatory measures we prepare," and adding, "It seems that candidates for party leader or supreme council members in the party convention are increasingly leaning towards completely abolishing the complementary investigation authority, mindful of the votes of hard-line party members." (보완수사권에 대한 숙의가 필요하다는 의견을 냈다는 수도권 재선 의원은 이날 한겨레와의 통화에서 “보완수사권을 완전 폐지하면 어떤 보완책을 마련하더라도 국민의 피해를 완전히 막기 어렵다”라며 “전당대회 당대표나 최고위원 후보들이 강성 당원들의 표심을 의식해서 보완수사권 완전 폐지 쪽으로 자꾸 방향을 잡아가는 것으로 보인다”고 우려했다.)

On the other hand, a second-term lawmaker with a legal background reportedly stated, "Even if the complementary investigation authority is partially retained, I hope proponents of its retention can prove that it will not be abused." However, it was reported that most lawmakers in the chat did not express their opinions at that time. (반면, 법조계 출신 재선 의원은 “보완수사권을 일부 남겨둘 경우에도 악용되지 않는다는 점을 존치론자들이 입증하면 좋겠다”는 입장을 밝혔다고 한다. 다만 당시 단체방에서 의원 대부분은 의견을 밝히지 않은 것으로 전해졌다.)

Ahead of the party convention in August, voices calling for the "complete abolition of the complementary investigation authority" are growing stronger within the Democratic Party, centered around party leadership contenders. Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party, said at a policy coordination meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "We will launch a task force (TF) for revising the Criminal Procedure Act, centered around the floor leadership, the Policy Committee, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, to begin practical discussions," and added, "We will swiftly devise measures to flawlessly complete the era's task of completely separating investigative authority and prosecutorial authority, and abolishing the complementary investigation authority." (오는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 민주당 내부에선 당권 주자들을 중심으로 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 목소리가 거세지고 있다. 한병도 민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 정책조정회의에서 “원내지도부와 정책위원회, 법제사법위원회를 중심으로 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)를 출범시켜 실무 논의를 시작하겠다”며 “수사권과 기소권의 완전한 분리, 보완수사권 폐지라는 시대적 과제를 빈틈없이 완수할 방안을 신속히 강구하겠다”고 말했다.)

Later that afternoon, Deputy Floor Leader for Policy Kim Han-gyu, Deputy Chair of the Social Division of the Policy Committee Park Sang-hyuk, and Judiciary Committee Secretary Kim Seung-won met to hold the first meeting to establish an internal discussion body within the party. Kim said, "We plan to swiftly compile the specific details of the bill by synthesizing already submitted bills and matters previously discussed within the party." (이날 오후 김한규 원내정책수석부대표와 박상혁 정책위 사회수석부의장, 김승원 법사위 간사가 만나 당내 논의기구를 만들기 위한 1차 회의를 진행했다. 김 수석은 “이미 발의된 법안들과 기존에 당내에서 논의했던 사항들을 종합하여 신속하게 법안의 구체적인 내용을 정리해 나갈 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee Says "Balanced Development and Advanced Industry Hubs Must Align... Not Achieved Through Pressure" (이 대통령 “균형발전·첨단 거점 일치 기회…압력으로 유치 못해”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd that he would "mobilize all available means to support" companies' investments in advanced industries in the Chungcheong region. He directly refuted opposition claims regarding the "Three Major Mega Projects," such as "regional discrimination" and "government-led management," asserting that "we must not approach this divisively." (이재명 대통령이 2일 기업들의 충청권 첨단산업 투자를 “가용한 모든 수단을 동원해 지원하겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’에 관한 야당 등의 ‘지역 차별’, ‘관치’ 주장에는 “분열적으로 접근하면 안 된다”고 정면 반박했다.)

At the "National Report on the Development Vision for Advanced Industries in the Chungcheong Region" held in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, President Lee remarked on the announcement by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Celltrion of a total of 392 trillion won in investments in advanced industries in the region: "We will never miss this critical opportunity to align the hub of balanced development with the hub of advanced industries into one." He added, "The government will actively support these decisions by mobilizing all available means so that the bold moves of companies can shine." This national report came three days after a similar event in Gwangju on the 30th of last month regarding the creation of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region. <<> At the report session, Samsung Display President Lee Cheong, SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung, and Celltrion Pharmaceutical President Yoo Young-ho announced investment plans totaling 392 trillion won, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) fabs, advanced packaging fabs, and biopharmaceutical production facilities. Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jung-kwan signed a "Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for Investment to Foster Advanced Industries in the Chungcheong Region" alongside company representatives. <<> Before the event, President Lee toured exhibits of artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductors and innovative displays with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung at the Samsung Display Asan Campus 2 in Asan, South Chungcheong Province. When Chairman Lee commented, "Due to the AI boom, demand has suddenly surged. We ran out of land at the Busan plant, and now even the land at our old Jochiwon and current Sejong plants is full. Samsung Electro-Mechanics is even asking the Sejong mayor for more land," President Lee replied, "So land is the issue. There's plenty down south," referring to the abundance of sites in the southwestern region. <<> President Lee also strongly criticized the "regional discrimination" and "government-led controversy" during the report session. "It's the role of the government and politics to align interests so that companies think, 'Investing in this region is better,'" he said. "We must not take an approach of complaining, 'Why aren't you doing it for us?' without making any such effort, and get angry." He added, "In today's world, where do companies relocate because of pressure? I've heard outdated ideas suggesting that I pressured Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong into making such a decision. Is that how investment attraction works? It's impossible. Thinking that we can force such investments through pressure or coercion, as in the era of government-led administration, is itself outdated." President Lee also emphasized at a senior secretary meeting held later that afternoon: "Through the Three Major Mega Projects, we will turn the entire country into a Korean version of Silicon Valley. This is not a handout to the regions but the only way for South Korea to become the ultimate winner of the Fourth Industrial Revolution." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 충남 아산시에서 열린 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’에서 삼성과 에스케이(SK)하이닉스, 셀트리온 등이 충청권에 총 392조원의 첨단산업 투자를 발표한 것에 대해 “균형 발전의 거점과 첨단산업 거점을 하나로 일치시킬 이 중대한 기회를 결코 놓치지 않을 것”이라며 “정부는 기업들의 결단이 빛을 발할 수 있도록 가용한 모든 수단을 동원해 적극적으로 지원하겠다”고 말했다. 이날 국민보고회는 지난달 30일 광주에서 열린 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 관련 국민보고회 뒤 사흘 만에 열렸다.)

item.title: Democratic Party forms task force on abolishing supplementary investigation powers… cautious voices within party (민주, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ TF 구성…당내선 신중론도)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 2nd that it will form an internal task force (TF) to discuss amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act, including whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. Amid this, there are also voices calling for carefully preparing measures to address side effects from the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers, or for maintaining them in a limited manner. <<> Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do said at a parliamentary policy coordination meeting that day, "We will launch a Criminal Procedure Act amendment task force centered on the floor leadership, the policy committee, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to begin practical discussions." The previous day, Floor Leader Han stated, "We will quickly finalize the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which is the last piece of prosecutorial reform." Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo also said, "We plan to present the committee's own bills next week and refer them to subcommittees," adding, "The Criminal Procedure Act is also included." <<> Meanwhile, cautious opinions emerged within the party. <<> Lawmaker Kim Young-jin, an original pro-Lee Jae-myung figure, said on MBC Radio that day, "There are aspects related to amending the Criminal Procedure Act and organizing various enforcement ordinances and guidelines accordingly," adding, "It is not appropriate to set a deadline too hastily and proceed that way." The previous day, former President Moon Jae-in, during a Blue House luncheon with President Lee Jae-myung, said regarding prosecutorial reform, "Speed is important, but I ask the government to push forward more carefully and thoroughly so that there are no damages or side effects for the people." <<> Additionally, it was confirmed that in the Democratic Party lawmakers' group chat, about four to five lawmakers recently expressed concerns about the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers. A first-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "We should conditionally recognize supplementary investigation powers only for cases where the police have sent the case with a recommendation for indictment, and for other cases, only recognize the right to request supplementary investigation—but if it involves a separate investigation, even that should not be granted," adding, "The intent is to check excessive police investigations and supplement insufficient investigations rushed by time constraints." A multi-term lawmaker with a legal background also told The Hankyoreh, "We need to discuss what to do in situations with high risk of evidence destruction, or when the statute of limitations is near expiration, or when there has been a serious human rights violation by the investigating police (if supplementary investigations are abolished)." <<> Reporters Jeong Hye-min and Kim Chae-woon jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 2일 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부 등 형사소송법 개정안을 논의할 당내 태스크포스(TF)를 구성하겠다고 밝혔다. 이런 가운데, 보완수사권 완전 폐지로 인한 부작용 대책을 신중히 마련하거나 제한적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 목소리도 나오고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Utilize Additional Tax Revenue to Create Investment Resources for Future Generations" (이 대통령 “추가 세수 활용해 미래 세대 투자 재원 조성”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung expressed on the 2nd his intention to invest the surplus tax revenue expected from the semiconductor boom into youth policies. (이재명 대통령이 2일 반도체 호황으로 예상되는 초과 세수를 청년 정책에 투자하겠다는 뜻을 표시했다.)

During a senior secretary meeting held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee stated, "I hope you will make every effort to efficiently utilize the anticipated additional tax revenue to establish stable investment resources for future generations." He outlined plans to use the surplus tax revenue, projected to exceed 40 trillion won this year due to the semiconductor export boom, to support the younger generation. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “최근에 예상되고 있는 추가 세수를 효율적으로 활용해 미래 세대를 위한 안정적인 투자 재원을 조성하는 데도 만전을 기해주길 바란다”고 말했다. 반도체 수출 호황에 따라 올해 40조원 규모를 웃돌 것으로 전망되는 초과 세수를 청년 세대 지원에 쓰겠다는 구상을 밝힌 것이다.)

President Lee had also mentioned the government's startup support project, the "Everyone's Startup" initiative, at a Cabinet meeting on March 23, saying, "Among considerations on how to use the additional tax revenue, improving the startup environment to secure growth potential is a major part," indicating his commitment to strengthening support for the youth. (이 대통령은 지난달 23일 청와대 국무회의에서도 정부 창업 지원 사업인 ‘모두의 창업’ 프로젝트를 언급하면서 “추가 세수를 어떻게 활용할지에 대한 고민 중에 성장 잠재력 확보를 위해 창업 환경을 개선하는 것도 큰 부분”이라고 말하며 청년층 지원 강화 의지를 표시했다.)

Regarding the "Culture and Arts Pass," which subsidizes costs for performances, exhibitions, and movies, President Lee proposed, "If this policy shows high satisfaction and tangible benefits for young people, consider planning ways to expand it or apply it to other policies," according to Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong. Explaining the "Three Mega Projects for Korea's Great Leap Forward," President Lee emphasized, "This path will take responsibility for Korea's next 30 years and open a larger window of opportunity for all youth across the nation. I urge the public, businesses, the government, and the political sphere to unite their efforts. We must do our utmost to build an asset ladder for everyone, including the youth." (이 대통령은 또 공연·전시·영화 관람비를 지원하는 ‘문화예술패스’에 대해서도 “(청년들의) 만족도와 체감도가 높은 정책이라면 확장 방안 및 다른 정책으로 응용해 적용할 수 있는 방안도 기획해보라”고 제안했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 전했다. 이 대통령은 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트’를 설명하며 “대한민국의 미래 30년을 책임지고, 전국의 모든 청년에게 더 큰 기회의 창을 열어줄 이 길에 국민과 기업, 정부, 정치권 모두 하나 된 힘을 모아달라. 청년을 포함한 모두의 자산 사다리 구축에 최선을 다해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

President Lee's recent repeated emphasis on strengthening youth policies is not unrelated to low approval ratings among the 2030 generation. According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) released on the same day by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research, positive evaluations among those in their 20s stood at 45% (negative evaluations 39%), lower than the average positive evaluation of 58% (negative evaluations 35%) across other age groups. (For details, refer to the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee.) (이 대통령이 최근 청년 정책 강화를 연이어 강조하는 것은 2030세대의 낮은 국정 지지도와 무관하지 않다. 이날 발표된 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치의 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과를 보면, 20대의 경우 긍정 평가가 45%(부정 평가 39%)로 다른 연령대의 평균 긍정 평가 58%(부정 평가 35%)보다 낮았다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-shik also announced on April 1 the establishment of a "Cheong Wa Dae Fellowship," allowing young people to directly evaluate national decision-making processes. (강훈식 대통령비서실장 역시 지난 1일 청년들이 국정 의사 결정을 직접 평가할 수 있는 ‘청와대 펠로십’을 신설하겠다고 말한 바 있다.)

Reporter Goh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Specialization or Jointness? Military Academy Integration Sparks Heated Debate (전문성이냐 합동성이냐…사관학교 통합 ‘뜨거운 감자’)
item.description:
The debate over merging the Army, Navy, and Air Force military academies into a single institution is intensifying. Proponents emphasize jointness, while opponents stress the importance of specialization. (육·해·공군 사관학교를 하나로 합치는 사관학교 통합을 두고 찬반 논란이 뜨겁다. 찬성하는 쪽은 합동성을, 반대하는 쪽은 전문성을 강조한다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-back stated at the All-Forces Key Commanders Meeting on the 1st, “The specialization of each service branch must be preserved. However, this specialization should not become a ‘silo,’ and jointness must be integrated into the military’s culture.” Strengthening jointness means that the Army, Navy, and Air Force should move beyond service-centric interests and develop the ability to conduct integrated operations across air, sea, and land. Minister Ahn emphasized, “Jointness must be instilled as a core trait through shared learning, training, and thinking from the military academy stage, which can then be refined and evolved in the field.” <<> The integration of military academies was a campaign pledge of President Lee Jae-myung and is now a national agenda item. In a speech on February 20 at the Gyeryongdae joint commissioning ceremony for graduates of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, President Lee stated, “We will integrate the three service academies to systematically cultivate defense talent capable of leading future battlefields.” <<> In contrast, the Korea Military Academy (KMA) Alumni Association and others argue that the fundamental role of a military academy is to enhance specialization. A KMA Alumni Association official said, “The Army, Navy, and Air Force academies are institutions for understanding the unique characteristics of each service and establishing their identity.” Some KMA graduates claim the integration is political retaliation aimed at shutting down the academy by labeling it a “hotbed of the December 3 insurrection.” <<> As the issue of military academy integration has devolved into a debate over the “closure of KMA,” discussions on finding practical improvements for current academy education have disappeared. <<> It seems clear that the current military academies have limitations in nurturing cadets who are suited for the era of convergence and possess a strong democratic civic consciousness through broad and diverse education. A particular problem is that the faculty is predominantly composed of active-duty officers who are alumni of their respective academies. As of 2024, civilian professors make up only 12.8% at KMA, 14.5% at the Naval Academy, and 11% at the Air Force Academy. In contrast, the proportion of civilian professors at U.S. service academies ranges from 30% to 50%. <<> Compared to general universities, each of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies has a small student body, limiting their ability to provide diverse and in-depth education. Annual admissions quotas are around 300 for KMA, 170 for the Naval Academy, and 200 for the Air Force Academy. <<> In recent years, competition rates and academic scores for military academies have plummeted, largely due to the institutions’ declining competitiveness as educational establishments. Cadets study for four years in a state isolated from society and then serve in the military until their 40s or 50s. In extreme cases, this can lead to prioritizing personal connections over public values, as seen with active-duty and retired generals from KMA during the December 3 insurrection. <<> The core of the recommendations submitted in January by the Ministry of National Defense’s “Civil-Military-Government Joint Special Advisory Committee, Military Academy Education Reform Subcommittee” was to establish a “National Defense University of Korea.” Under this plan, the existing Army, Navy, and Air Force academies would become constituent colleges within the university. Cadets would receive foundational knowledge and basic major education in their first and second years, then proceed to advanced major courses and military training at their respective service academies in their third and fourth years. <<> The Ministry of National Defense plans to finalize the bill for establishing the National Defense University within this year. If so, it would implement admissions procedures next year, with integrated selection considered starting in the 2028 academic year. This would currently apply to students in their sophomore year of high school. However, the Higher Education Act stipulates that universities must announce their admission implementation plans at least one year and ten months before the start of the admission year. The plan for the 2028 academic year should have been announced last May. This inevitably creates confusion for prospective military academy applicants. <<> Kwon Hyuk-chul Reporter nura@hani.co.kr ( 안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 1일 전군주요지휘관회의에서 “각 군의 전문성은 반드시 지켜져야 한다. 그러나 그 전문성이 ‘칸막이’가 되어서는 안 되고, 합동성을 체질화해야 한다”고 말했다. 합동성 강화는 육·해·공군이 자군 이기주의에 빠지지 않고 하늘과 바다, 육지에서 함께 유기적으로 작전을 수행할 수 있는 능력을 키워야 한다는 뜻이다. 안 장관은 “합동성은 사관학교에서부터 함께 배우고 훈련하고 생각하는 과정을 통해 체질화시킨 후에 야전에서 더 다듬고 진화시켜 나가야 한다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "The ruling party cannot win just by saying 'that person is bad'... Must make hearts race" (김민석 “여당은 ‘저 사람 나빠요’만 갖고 승리 못 해…가슴 뛰게 해야”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, former prime minister preparing to run in the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea convention, said on the 3rd regarding competitors former leader Jeong Cheong-rae and lawmaker Song Young-gil, "The two of you have already served as party leaders, but I have not yet done so." He added, "The general election is in two years, and I am the only person within the party who has directly overseen and led victories in general elections, presidential elections, and local elections." (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회 출마를 준비 중인 김민석 전 국무총리는 3일 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표와 송영길 의원을 향해 “두 분은 당대표를 이미 해보셨고, 저는 아직 안 해봤다”며 “2년 후 총선인데, 저는 당내에서 총선·대선·지방선거를 다 직접 총괄 지휘하고 승리까지 이끌어 본 유일한 사람”이라고 말했다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio's "Park Seong-tae's News Show" on the 2nd, former Prime Minister Kim said, "I have experience winning, and I have a firm direction on how to win." He cited his key experiences as the general director of the local elections in 2010 when the Democratic Party won big, the general election situation room chief during Lee Jae-myung's term as party leader in 2024, and head of the presidential election governance plan office last year. (김 전 총리는 2일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 “이겨본 경험이 있고, 이렇게 하면 이길 수 있다는 방향을 확고하게 가지고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 그가 꼽은 주요 경험은 2010년 민주당이 대승한 지방선거 총괄본부장, 2024년 이재명 당대표 시절 총선 상황실장, 지난해 대선 집권플랜본부장 등이다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim further stated, "The Democratic Party, as a traditional policy-oriented party and a party of member sovereignty, must also adopt youth, culture, and dignity as key keywords as the ruling party." He emphasized, "When the ruling party talks about elections, it cannot win just by saying 'that person is bad.' It must make people's hearts race with what it plans to do." He added, "To do that, our attitudes, expressions, and even facial expressions in communicating with the people and opposing political forces need to change a bit more." (김 전 총리는 그러면서 “민주당이 전통적인 정책 정당, 당원 주권 정당에 더해 집권여당으로서 청년, 문화, 품격, 이 세가지를 중요한 키워드로 삼아야 한다”며 “여당이 선거만 놓고 얘기할 때 ‘저 사람 나빠요’ 그런 얘기만 갖고 승리할 수 없다. 어떻게 하겠다는 것으로 가슴 뛰게 만들어야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “그러자면 국민들, 상대 정치 세력과 소통하는 태도나 표현, 표정 같은 것들도 조금 더 변해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding recent concerns within the party about the side effects of abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, former Prime Minister Kim said, "The government has already considered everything comprehensively and decided to abolish supplementary investigation powers. Remaining issues should be minimized through the legislative process." He added, "Various critiques and solutions have been raised from many sides, so the National Assembly can choose from among them." He noted, "Former leader Jeong has repeatedly said that the right to request supplementary investigation should be maintained, while former (Innovation Party) leader Cho Kuk said some exceptions should be allowed for supplementary investigation powers. I'm not sure about their recent positions." (김 전 총리는 최근 검찰 보완수사권 폐지의 부작용에 대한 당내 우려와 관련해 “정부가 이미 종합적인 고려를 거쳐 결론을 낸 것이 보완수사권 폐지이고, 남아 있는 문제는 입법 과정에서 최대한 문제를 최소화하는 거로 정리해 가면 된다”며 “여기저기서 제기됐던 문제의식과 해법들이 다양하게 축적돼 있으니, 그런 것 중에서 국회가 취사선택하면 된다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “정 전 대표도 보완수사요구권은 해야 되는 거 아니냐는 말씀을 여러번 주셨고, 조국 전 (조국혁신당) 대표는 오히려 보완수사권의 예외를 일부 줘야 되는 거 아니냐는 얘기를 하셨었다”며 “최근에는 어떤지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Second 3600-ton Advanced Submarine Named 'Seoheui-ham'…to Be Launched in Second Half of the Year (두번째 3600t급 최신형 잠수함 이름은 ‘서희함’…하반기 진수)
item.description:
The name of the second 3600-ton-class advanced submarine of the Jang Bogo-III Batch-II, operated by the Republic of Korea Navy, has been designated as Seoheui-ham, after the Goryeo Dynasty diplomat Seo Heui (942–998). (해군의 3600t급 최신형 잠수함인 장보고-Ⅲ 배치(Batch)-Ⅱ 2번함의 함명은 고려 시대 외교가 서희(942∼998)의 이름을 딴 서희함으로 정해졌다.)

The Navy announced on the 3rd that the Naval Headquarters' Ship Naming Committee had selected 'Seoheui-ham' as the name for the second ship of the Jang Bogo-III Batch-II, a Jang Yeong-sil-class submarine. Seo Heui is a historical figure who, when the Khitan led a large army to invade Goryeo, visited the enemy commander and persuaded him that avoiding war would also benefit the Khitan, leading to the withdrawal of enemy forces and the acquisition of the six eastern districts (Gangdong 6-ju). The Navy explained, "It was evaluated that the outstanding military and diplomatic achievements of the great statesman Seo Heui, along with his spirit of overcoming national crises, are well-suited for the name of a submarine, a core asset in maritime defense." (해군은 해군본부 함명제정위원회를 통해 장영실함급 잠수함인 장보고-Ⅲ 배치-Ⅱ2번함의 함명을 ‘서희함’으로 제정했다고 3일 밝혔다. 서희는 거란이 대군을 이끌고 고려를 침공하자 적장을 찾아가 전쟁을 하지 않는 것이 거란을 위해서도 좋다고 설득해 적군을 철수시키고 강동 6주를 얻어낸 인물이다. 해군은 “명재상 서희의 탁월한 군사·외교적 업적과 국난 극복의 정신이 해양 수호의 핵심 전력인 잠수함의 함명으로 적합하다고 평가했다”고 설명했다.)

The Navy has traditionally named submarines after figures who have contributed to military power, maritime strength, scientific and technological advancement, or resistance against foreign forces and independence movements, earning national respect. The first ship of the Jang Bogo-III Batch-II is named 'Jang Yeong-sil-ham', and subsequent ships are classified as the Jang Yeong-sil class. (해군은 군사력·해양력·과학기술 발전이나 외세와의 항쟁, 독립운동 등에 기여해 국민적 존경을 받는 인물을 잠수함 함명으로 삼아왔다. 장보고-Ⅲ 배치-Ⅱ1번함 이름은 ‘장영실함’이며 후속함은 ‘장영실급’으로 분류되고 있다.)

The submarine built under Jang Bogo-III Batch-II (3600 tons, length 89m) has a larger external size and significantly improved performance compared to the Batch-I Dosan Ahn Chang-ho class (3000 tons, length 83m). Improvements to combat and sonar systems have enhanced target detection and processing capabilities. It is also reported that the number of vertical launch tubes for submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs) has been increased from 6 to 10. (장보고-Ⅲ 배치-Ⅱ로 건조되는 잠수함(3600t급·길이 89m)은 배치-Ⅰ인 도산안창호급(3000t급·길이 83m)보다 외형이 커지고 성능도 크게 개선됐다. 전투 및 소나체계 성능 개선으로 표적 탐지와 처리 능력이 향상됐다. 수중에서 잠수함발사탄도미사일(SLBM)을 발사하는 수직발사관 숫자도 6개에서 10개로 늘어난 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Jang Bogo-III Batch-II is also the model proposed by South Korea for the Canadian Submarine Program (CPSP), where the announcement of the preferred bidder is imminent. (장보고-Ⅲ 배치-Ⅱ는 우선협상대상자 발표가 임박한 캐나다 잠수함 사업(CPSP)에 한국이 제안한 모델이기도 하다.)

Seoheui-ham is scheduled to be delivered to the Navy in 2028, and although the launch ceremony date has not been confirmed, it is expected to be launched in the second half of this year. (서희함은 2028년 해군 인도 예정이며, 진수식 일정은 확정되지 않았으나 올해 하반기 중 진수가 예상된다.)

Meanwhile, the Navy has named the fifth 3600-ton-class new frigate, measuring 129m in length and 14.8m in width, 'Pyeongtaek-ham'. The Navy has assigned names of special cities, metropolitan cities, provinces, provincial capital locations, and medium-sized/small cities to frigates. Pyeongtaek was chosen as it is the location of the Navy's 2nd Fleet Command, where Pyeongtaek-ham will be deployed. The Navy explained that this considers the security symbolism of the site being a key naval base for defending the West Sea. Pyeongtaek-ham is scheduled to be delivered to the Navy next year. (한편 해군은 길이 129m, 폭 14.8m의 3600t급 신형 호위함 5번함 함명은 ‘평택함’으로 명명했다. 해군은 특별·광역시 및 도, 도청 소재지 및 중·소도시 이름을 호위함에 붙여왔다. 앞으로 평택함이 배치될 해군 2함대 사령부가 있는 평택을 딴 것으로, 서해 수호를 위한 핵심 해군기지 소재지라는 안보 상징성을 고려했다고 해군은 설명했다. 평택함은 내년 해군에 인도 예정이다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating at 54%... 'Withhold Judgment' on Prime Minister Han Sung-sook at 46% [Gallup] (이 대통령 지지율 54%…한성숙 총리 ‘판단 유보’ 46% [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 3rd showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's governance stand at 54%. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가가 54%를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 3일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from June 30 to July 2 targeting 1,005 voters nationwide aged 18 and older (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via mobile phone virtual number interviews), positive ratings for the president's job performance were 54%, while negative ratings were 36%. In Gallup's previous survey (conducted June 23-25), positive ratings were 51% and negative 41%, marking the lowest positive approval rating since taking office. (한국갤럽이 지난 6월30일∼7월2일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1005명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰) 결과를 보면, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정평가는 54%, 부정평가는 36%였다. 갤럽의 지난주 발표(6월23~25일 조사)에선 긍정 51%, 부정 41%로, 긍정평가가 취임 뒤 최저치를 기록한 바 있다.)

Reasons cited for positive evaluations included economy and livelihoods (24%), diplomacy (14%), and a general sense of doing well (8%). Negative evaluations were attributed to economy, livelihoods, and high exchange rates (16%), real estate policy (9%), and authoritarianism and arbitrariness (7%). (긍정 평가 이유로는 경제·민생(24%), 외교(14%), 전반적으로 잘한다(8%) 등이 꼽혔다. 부정 평가 이유로는 경제·민생·고환율(16%), 부동산 정책(9%), 독재·독단(7%) 등이 지목됐다.)

In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea remained at 41%, the same as the previous week. The People Power Party recorded 26%. The Rebuilding Korea Party and Reform Party each received 2%, while the Progressive Party and Basic Income Party each got 1%. Undecided voters accounted for 25%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 지난주와 같은 41%였다. 국민의힘은 26%를 기록했다. 조국혁신당·개혁신당이 각각 2%, 진보당·기본소득당이 각각 1%였다. 무당층은 25%로 나타났다.)

When asked about the suitability of new Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, who took office on the 2nd, 46% withheld judgment. 31% said she was 'suitable,' while 23% considered her 'unsuitable.' (지난 2일 취임한 한성숙 신임 국무총리 적합 여부를 물은 결과, 46%는 판단을 유보했다. 31%가 ‘적합하다’고 답했고, 23%는 ‘적합하지 않다’고 봤다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Positive Evaluation of Real Estate Policy Plummets from 51% to 26%… "Jeonse Has Many Advantages and Is Necessary" 54% [Gallup] (부동산정책 긍정평가 51%→26% 뚝…“전세 장점 많고 필요” 54% [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 3rd showed that negative evaluations of the government's real estate policy have risen significantly to 46%, compared to 27% in March. (정부의 부동산 정책에 대한 부정 평가가 46%로, 지난 3월 27%보다 크게 높아졌다는 여론조사가 3일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from June 30 to July 2 targeting 1,005 voters aged 18 and over nationwide (with a 95% confidence level and a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points, using mobile phone virtual number interviews), 26% of respondents said the government is doing well with its real estate policy, while 46% said it is doing poorly. 28% reserved their opinion. (한국갤럽이 지난 6월30일∼7월2일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1005명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰)를 보면, 정부의 부동산 정책에 대해 ‘잘하고 있다'는 응답은 26%로, ‘잘못하고 있다'는 응답은 46%로 나타났다. 28%는 의견을 유보했다.)

The positive rating for real estate policy had risen to 51% in the March 3-5 survey, but has returned to a low point after four months. By age group, negative evaluations were highest among those in their 30s at 56%, followed by those in their 20s or younger and those 70 or older at 51% each, those in their 60s at 44%, those in their 40s at 41%, and those in their 50s at 35%. By political inclination, compared to the March survey, positive evaluations halved from 55% to 24% among moderates, and also declined among progressives (from 74% to 47%) and conservatives (from 34% to 16%). (부동산 정책 긍정 평가는 지난 3월3∼5일 조사에서 51%까지 상승했으나, 4개월 만에 저점으로 되돌아 갔다. 연령대별로 부정 평가는 30대가 56%로 가장 많았고, 20대 이하와 70대 이상이 각각 51%, 60대 44%, 40대 41%, 50대 35% 순이었다. 성향별로 보면 3월 조사와 견줘 중도층에서는 긍정 평가가 55%에서 24%로 반감했고, 진보층(74%→47%)과 보수층(34%→16%)에서도 하락했다.)

When asked about the reasons for their negative evaluation of the real estate policy (460 respondents, open-ended responses), the top reasons included failure to curb rising housing prices (21%), limitations on loan limits (10%), and excessive regulations (8%). (부동산 정책을 부정 평가한 이유를 물은 결과(460명, 자유응답)는 집값 상승 억제 못 함(21%), 대출 한도 제한(10%), 과도한 규제(8%) 등을 꼽았다.)

Regarding the outlook for housing prices over the next year, 55% of respondents said they would rise. 14% said they would fall, 21% said there would be no change, and 10% reserved their opinion. In the survey conducted on March 3-5 after the announcement of the 'January 29 Metropolitan Area Housing Supply Plan,' the view that housing prices would fall dominated at 46%, surpassing the view that they would rise (29%), but this time, the view that housing prices will rise has regained dominance. (향후 1년간 집값 전망에 대해선 응답자의 55%가 ‘오를 것'이라고 답했다. ‘내릴 것' 14%, ‘변화 없을 것' 21%, 의견 유보 10%다. 지난 1월 ‘1·29 수도권 주택공급 방안 발표’ 이후 3월 3∼5일 조사에서는 집값 하락론이 46%로, 집값 상승론(29%)와 견줘 우위를 기록했으나, 이번에 다시 집값 상승론 우위로 바뀌었다.)

Additionally, regarding rent and lease deposits for the next year, 65% predicted they would rise. 8% said they would fall, 19% said there would be no change, and 8% reserved their opinion. Unlike housing prices, the outlook for rental costs has continued to lean toward increases since 2024. (또, 앞으로 1년간 전·월세 등 주택 임대료에 대해서는 65%가 ‘오를 것'이라고 전망했다. 8%는 ‘내릴 것', 19%는 ‘변화 없을 것'이라고 봤다. 8%는 의견을 유보했다. 집값과 달리 임대료 전망은 2024년 이후 상승론이 계속 우위를 지키고 있다.)

Regarding the jeonse (lump-sum deposit) system, for which the government has mentioned the need for institutional improvement, 54% responded that it has more advantages and is a necessary system going forward. 28% said it has more disadvantages and should be phased out, while 19% reserved their opinion. (정부가 제도 개선 필요성을 언급한 부동산 전세 제도와 관련해선 54%가 ‘장점이 더 많고, 향후에도 필요한 제도'라고 답했다. ‘단점이 더 많고, 향후 사라져야 할 제도'라는 응답은 28%였고, 19%는 의견을 유보했다.)

For further details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: "Still defaming the May 18th?" Han Byung-do, choked with emotion..."Regardless of conservative or progressive, as a human being, that should not be done." (“아직도 5·18 폄훼하나” 울먹인 한병도…“보수·진보 떠나 사람이라면 그러면 안 돼”)
item.description:
<<>> "On May 18th, countless citizens confirmed the deaths of children at the scene and wailed in grief. If you could even slightly fathom that pain, how can you defile the May 18th? A person should not act that way. I sincerely hope this does not happen." (Han Byung-do, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea) ()

At the Democratic Party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 3rd, party leadership continued to criticize remarks by People Power Party figures who called the Baejae High School baseball team's "Starbucks cheering song" an expression of freedom. ( “5·18 당시 수많은 시민이 현장에서 아이들의 죽음을 확인하고 울부짖었습니다. 그 마음을 눈곱만큼이라도 헤아린다면 어떻게 5·18을 폄훼할 수가 있겠습니까? 사람이 그러면 안 되잖아요. 정말 안 이랬으면 좋겠습니다.” (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표))

Floor Leader Han Byung-do said, "Just thinking that some are still defaming the May 18th and talking about it breaks my heart," before trailing off. He continued, "The May 18th was an event where the military dictatorship fired guns and stabbed at the people to reclaim power. Our families fell. It's not a complicated story," and added with a trembling voice, "Regardless of being progressive or conservative, as a human being, you should not joke about or defile something like this." He then said, "I earnestly hope that such acts of defaming and ridiculing this historical event, whose pain still lingers, never happen again in South Korea." ( 3일 국회에서 열린 민주당 최고위원회의에서는 배재고 야구부의 ‘스타벅스 응원가’가 “표현의 자유”라는 국민의힘 인사들 발언을 향해 민주당 지도부의 비판이 이어졌다.)

Supreme Council Member Hwang Myung-sun stated, "Mocking the May 18th is not freedom of expression; it is discriminatory violence. Gwangju Ilgo is a school that directly experienced the May 18th. Yet the People Power Party is defending the act of mocking those alumni by exploiting that painful history as freedom of expression. This is unbecoming of the primary opposition party." He added, "Discriminatory violence rooted in hatred and historical distortion can never coexist with the freedom of expression guaranteed by the South Korean Constitution. This is not just a simple deviation; it is a criminal act." Supreme Council Member Moon Jung-bok said, "We will take this opportunity to establish a new system centered on constitutional values education, including comprehensive support for democratic citizenship education." ( 한병도 원내대표는 “아직도 5·18을 폄훼하고 5·18과 관련된 이야기를 하고 있다고 생각하면 마음이 아리다”며 말을 잇지 못했다. 그는 “5·18은 군사 독재 정권이 정권을 탈환하기 위해 국민에게 총을 쐈다. 칼로 찔렀다. 우리의 가족들이 쓰러져 나간 사건인 것이다. 복잡한 이야기가 아니”라며 “진보·보수를 떠나서 사람이라면 이런 걸 가지고 장난치고 폄훼하고 그러면 안 되는 것”이라며 울먹였다. 이어 “그 아픔이 아직도 남아 있는 역사적 사건을 폄훼하고 조롱하는 이런 일이 대한민국에서 다시는 일어나지 않기를 간절히 소망한다”고 말했다.)

When asked by reporters after the meeting, "Does the party have a stance on the penalty against Baejae High School baseball players, suspending them from national competitions for six months?", Kang Joon-hyun, the Democratic Party's Senior Spokesperson, replied, "There has been no internal discussion regarding the disciplinary action." However, he noted, "We believe the fault of the political sphere and adults is significant, and there is also a sense of concern that proper history education programs are not being implemented in the educational field." He added, "The party should examine whether the educational field is fostering or neglecting hatred." He continued, "This situation should not be exploited as a tool for political strife," and urged, "We ask the People Power Party to join us in creating an educational environment free from discrimination, hate speech, and historical distortion." ( 황명선 최고위원은 “5·18 조롱은 표현의 자유가 아니고 차별적 폭력”이라며 “광주일고는 5·18을 직접 겪었던 학교다. 그런데 국민의힘은 그 아픈 역사를 가지고 그 후배들을 조롱하는 행위를 표현의 자유라고 옹호하고 있다. 이건 제1야당이 할 짓이 아니다”라고 했다. 이어 “혐오와 역사 왜곡에 기반한 차별적 폭력은 결코 대한민국 헌법이 보장하는 표현의 자유와 양립할 수 없다. 단순한 일탈이 아니라 범죄적 행위”라고 말했다. 문정복 최고위원은 “이번 기회에 민주시민교육지원을 포괄한 헌법 가치 교육을 중심으로 하는 새로운 제도를 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

By Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 회의 뒤 ‘배재고 야구부 선수들의 전국대회 6개월 출전 정지 징계에 대한 당 입장이 있냐’는 취재진 질문에 “징계 처분 관련해 내부적으로 논의된 바는 없다”고 답했다. 다만 “저희 정치권이나 어른들의 잘못도 크다고 보고, 교육 현장에서 제대로 된 역사 교육 프로그램이 제대로 안 되고 있지 않나 하는 문제의식도 있다”며 “교육 현장에서 혐오를 조장·방치하고 있는 건 아닌지 당에서 점검해봐야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “이 상황이 정쟁 수단으로 활용돼선 안 된다”며 “국민의힘도 차별·혐오 표현과 역사 왜곡이 없는 교육 현장을 만드는 데에 함께해주시길 요청드린다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: President Lee to Engage in 'Defense Diplomacy' at NATO on July 7-8… State Visit to Mongolia on July 9-11 (이 대통령, 7~8일 나토서 ‘방산 외교’ 나선다…9~11일엔 몽골 국빈방문)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will attend the NATO summit to be held in Ankara, Türkiye, on July 7-8, at the invitation of NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. (이재명 대통령이 마르크 뤼터 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 사무총장의 초청으로 오는 7~8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 개최되는 나토 정상회의에 참석한다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-rak announced this at a briefing at the Cheong Wa Dae Chunchugwan on the 3rd. President Lee is scheduled to arrive in Ankara on the afternoon of the 7th, hold a meeting with Secretary General Rutte, and then participate in a small-group meeting with representatives from Indo-Pacific partner countries including Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. He will also attend the NATO Defense Industry Forum, one of the official events of the summit. Director Wi stated, "This defense industry forum reflects the current top interest of NATO allies in strengthening the defense industry base, and is being promoted as a core event of this year's NATO summit, with nearly 1,000 attendees expected." President Lee will deliver a keynote speech and participate in a panel discussion under the theme "Shared Values, Stronger Industrial Base." (위성락 국가안보실장은 3일 청와대 춘추관 브리핑에서 이렇게 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 7일 오후 앙카라에 도착해 뤼터 사무총장과 면담을 한 뒤 일본·오스트레일리아·뉴질랜드 등 인도·태평양 파트너국 대표들과 소인수 회담을 한다. 또 이번 정상회의 공식 행사 중 하나인 나토 방위산업포럼에 참석한다. 위 실장은 “이번 방산포럼은 현재 나토 동맹국들의 최대 관심사가 방위산업 기반 강화인 점을 반영해 올해 나토 정상회의의 핵심 행사로 추진중이며, 1천명 가까운 청중이 참석할 것으로 예상된다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 ‘공동의 가치, 더욱 강한 산업기반’을 주제로 한 세션에서 기조발언을 하고, 패널 토론에도 참여할 예정이다.)

Following this, President Lee will pay a state visit to Mongolia from July 9-11 at the invitation of Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh. This marks the first state visit by a South Korean president to Mongolia in 15 years. On the 9th, President Lee will arrive in Ulaanbaatar, participate in an official welcome ceremony held at the Mongolian Government House, and hold a summit with President Khürelsükh. The two leaders will then oversee an exchange ceremony of agreements and Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs), followed by a joint press statement. (이어 이 대통령은 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령의 초청으로 9~11일 몽골을 국빈방문한다. 대한민국 대통령의 몽골 국빈방문은 15년 만이다. 이 대통령은 9일 몽골 울란바타르에 도착해 몽골 정부청사에서 개최되는 공식 환영식에 참석한 뒤 후렐수흐 대통령과 정상회담을 한다. 이후 양국 정상은 협정·양해각서(MOU) 교환식 및 공동언론발표를 연다.)

On the 10th, President Lee is scheduled to visit the memorial hall of patriot Lee Tae-jun, who provided medical services and supported the independence movement in Mongolia, and later hold a luncheon meeting with South Korean residents in Mongolia. He will then meet separately with Chairman of the State Great Khural Sandagiin Byambatsogt and Prime Minister Nyam-Osor Oyuun-Erdene, urging efforts at the Mongolian parliamentary and government levels to develop South Korea-Mongolia relations. That evening, he will attend a state banquet hosted by President Khürelsükh. On the 11th, President Lee is expected to attend the opening ceremony of Mongolia's largest festival, the "Naadam Festival," as the guest of honor alongside President Khürelsükh. (10일에는 몽골에서 인술을 펼치며 독립운동을 지원한 이태준 열사 기념관을 방문한 뒤, 몽골 내 우리 교민들과 오찬 간담회를 할 예정이다. 이어 산다긴 뱜바척트 국회의장, 냠오소르 오츠랄 총리를 각각 접견하고, 한-몽골 관계 발전을 위한 몽골 국회와 정부 차원의 노력을 당부할 예정이다. 이날 저녁에는 후렐수흐 대통령 주최 국빈만찬에 참석한다. 11일에는 후렐수흐 대통령과 함께 몽골 최대 명절인 ‘나담축제’ 개막식에 주빈으로 참석할 예정이다.)

Director Wi commented, "Mongolia, as North Korea's second diplomatic partner after the former Soviet Union, maintains traditional friendly relations with North Korea, and thus possesses diplomatic assets that can contribute to advancing the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Through this visit, we aim to discuss ways to ensure peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, ease regional tensions, and build trust between the two leaders, while exploring feasible paths to resume dialogue with North Korea." (위 실장은 “몽골은 과거 소련에 이은 북한의 2번째 수교국으로서 북한과 전통적 우호관계를 유지하고 있는 만큼, 한반도 정세 진전에 기여할 수 있는 외교적 자산을 보유하고 있다”며 “이번 방문을 계기로 양국 정상간 한반도의 평화와 안정, 역내 긴장 완화와 신뢰 구축 방안을 논의하면서 북한과의 대화를 재개하기 위한 실현가능한 길을 모색해 나가고자 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. 'Defends Coupang,' Says Presidential Office: "No Targeted Investigations, No Discrimination Based on Nationality" (미국 쿠팡 감싸자 청와대 “표적조사 없다, 국적 따라 차별 안 해”)
item.description:
The presidential office stated on the 3rd, in response to a report by Republicans on the U.S. House Judiciary Committee alleging that the South Korean government had discriminatory targeted attacks on Coupang and others, "We do not discriminate based on nationality, nor do we target anyone for investigations." (청와대가 3일 미국 하원 법사위원회 공화당 쪽이 한국 정부가 쿠팡 등을 차별적으로 공격했다는 보고서를 낸 데 대해 “우리는 국적에 따라 차별적으로 대처하거나 누구를 표적화해서 조사하거나 그러지 않는다”고 말했다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said at a briefing at the Cheong Wa Dae Chunchugwan, "The investigation into Coupang is being conducted non-discriminatorily in accordance with domestic laws and due process. The content of the report claiming the investigation is discriminatory is significantly different from the facts." This came after the U.S. House Judiciary Committee's Republican side released a 35-page interim investigation report on the 1st (local time) titled "Blocking Competition: South Korea's Discriminatory Attacks on U.S.-Owned Companies." The report alleged that the South Korean government had continuously targeted Coupang, and after a personal information leak incident, mobilized the National Intelligence Service (NIS) and regulatory agencies to impose excessive investigations and pressure on Coupang. In response, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the NIS previously expressed regret that the report "unilaterally reflects only the claims of Coupang." (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 청와대 춘추관 브리핑에서 “쿠팡 조사는 국내법에 따라 적법절차에 따라 비차별적으로 이뤄지고 있다. 해당 조사가 차별적이라는 보고서의 내용은 사실과 크게 다르다”며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 미 하원 법사위 공화당 쪽은 지난 1일(현지시각) ‘경쟁 차단: 미국 소유 기업에 대한 한국의 차별적 공격’이라는 제목의 35쪽짜리 중간 조사 보고서를 발표했다. 보고서에는 한국 정부가 쿠팡을 지속해서 표적으로 삼아왔고, 개인정보 유출 사건 이후 국정원과 규제기관 등을 동원해 쿠팡에 과도한 조사와 압박을 가했다는 내용이 담겼다. 이에 대해 외교부와 국정원은 “쿠팡 쪽의 주장만을 일방적으로 반영하고 있다는 점에 대해서 유감을 표한다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Director Wi said, "It seems the company (Coupang) and our government view this issue differently. According to the investigations by our relevant agencies, over 33 million pieces of personal information were leaked, which the company itself has acknowledged. Notably, a Chinese former employee of Coupang leaked information from China, and access records of 33 million individuals were confirmed." He continued, "This information may also include data of Americans living among us. If personal information equivalent to two-thirds of the U.S. population were leaked in China and its whereabouts unknown, that would be a serious issue." He added, "The government will contact the U.S. administration and Congress to convey accurate information. We will make it clear that we do not discriminate against or target tech companies from any country, and we will explain that we are faithfully implementing the commitments in the Joint Fact Sheet." (위 실장은 “이 사안을 보는 관점이 해당 기업(쿠팡)과 우리 정부가 다른 거 같다”며 “우리 해당 기관 조사에 따르면 3300만건 이상의 인적 정보가 유출된 것으로 돼 있고, 해당 기업도 시인한 바 있다. 특히 쿠팡의 전직 직원인 중국인이 중국에서 정보를 유출했고, 3300만명의 접속기록이 확인된다”고 말했다. 위 실장은 이어 “그 속에는 (우리 국민과) 함께 살고 있는 미국인 정보도 있을 수 있다”며 “만약 미국인의 3분의 2에 해당하는 인적 정보가 중국에서 유출돼 어디로 갔는지 모른다면, 심각한 이슈가 아닐 수 없을 것”이라고 되물었다. 그러면서 “정부는 (미국) 행정부와 의회를 접촉해 정확한 정보를 전달하는 노력을 할 것”이라며 “어느 나라 테크 기업이라고 하더라도 차별적 대우를 하거나 표적화하는 일 없음을 알려갈 것이고 조인트 팩트 시트 상 약속을 충실히 이행하고 있다는 걸 설명할 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Director Wi also denied claims that a high-ranking Cheong Wa Dae official instructed Coupang to "closely cooperate with the NIS to retrieve a former employee's device and hand it over to the NIS." He stated, "Cheong Wa Dae was not aware that the equipment related to the personal information leak was retrieved from China. I first heard that a Coupang official had retrieved it in mid-December (last year), and that was the first time." He emphasized, "We are coordinating with the U.S. side to correct the facts. We will work to ensure this issue does not expand excessively and cause disruptions in other areas of South Korea-U.S. relations." (위 실장은 대통령실 고위 인사가 쿠팡에 ‘국정원과 긴밀히 협조해 전직 직원의 기기를 회수하고 국정원에 전달하라’고 지시했다는 내용도 사실과 다르다고 밝혔다. 위 실장은 “청와대는 개인정보 유출 장비를 중국에서 회수한 걸 알고 있었던 게 아니다”라며 “(지난해) 12월 중순 쿠팡 관계자가 회수한 사실이 있었다는 걸 들은 적이 있는데 그게 처음”이라고 선을 그었다. 그러면서 “사실관계를 바로 잡으려 미국 측과 협의하고 있다”며 “이 사안이 과도하게 커져서 다른 한-미 관계 영역에 파장이 없도록 노력할 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the White House's statement on the 2nd expressing concerns about "discriminatory targeting of U.S. tech companies," Director Wi said, "We will continue to communicate and ensure understanding. It seems the story of the interested party, the company, is being unilaterally reflected, but in South Korea, it is a subject of investigation and a suspect. We will work to isolate or separate this issue so it does not affect other matters between South Korea and the U.S." (위 실장은 백악관이 2일 성명을 통해 “미국 기술 기업에 대한 차별적 표적화”라는 우려를 나타낸 것에 대해서는 “계속 소통하고 이해시킬 것이다. 지금 해당 이해당사자인 기업의 얘기가 일방 반영된 거 같은데, 한국에서는 수사대상이고 피의자”라며 “한-미 간 다른 이슈에 영향을 주지 않도록 격리 내지 분리하도록 노력하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok, Song Young-gil, and Jeong Cheong-rae Gather in One Place… Smiling Brightly, But (한 자리 모인 김민석·송영길·정청래…환하게 웃고 있지만)
item.description:
Three candidates considered leading contenders in the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention for party leader election gathered in one place on the 3rd. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 유력 주자로 꼽히는 3명이 3일 한 자리에 모였다.)

Former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and lawmaker Song Young-gil attended a workshop for Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers held at a hotel in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, that day. While seats were assigned by National Assembly standing committee, they sat together at the “leadership table” alongside floor leader Han Byeong-do, Prime Minister Han Seong-suk, and Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik. <<> Lawmaker Song met with reporters at the workshop venue that day and said, “For our Democratic Party to move forward, we must present clear measures and a vision for people in their 20s and 30s.” He added, “The theme Chairman Xi Jinping adopted for the 105th anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party was precisely youth. The fact that the theme of the world’s largest political party is youth carries a very significant implication for the Democratic Party as well.” He continued, “I have a plan to invest 23 trillion won to support sending 10,000 people annually abroad for a year to study local regions and cultures, and I am preparing a groundbreaking solution to youth housing issues.” <<> Former Representative Jeong paid a visit to the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery in Gwangju ahead of the workshop. On his Facebook page, he stated, “In line with the era of Lee Jae-myung’s national sovereignty, I will complete the era of party member sovereignty.” He added, “I will ensure the spirit of the May 18 Democratic Uprising is enshrined in the preamble of the Constitution, and firmly support South Jeolla Province and Gwangju in leaping beyond being a sanctuary of democracy to become a mecca for locally-led growth and balanced national development.” He further said, “I am prepared to sacrifice everything for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the upcoming general election victory, and the re-creation of the government,” and “I will pursue integration and solidarity with the broader democratic and progressive forces outside the Democratic Party.” <<> Former Prime Minister Kim appeared on CBS Radio’s “Park Seong-tae’s News Show” that morning and said, “Beyond being a traditional policy-oriented party and a party member sovereignty party, the Democratic Party, as the ruling party, must adopt youth, culture, and dignity as key keywords.” He added, “When a ruling party only talks about elections with rhetoric like ‘that person is bad,’ it cannot win with just that. It must make people’s hearts race with what it plans to do.” He stated, “The party supports, backs, and follows the government, but on the other hand, there are clearly areas where it must lead the government, and we must move in that direction.” <<> This event was a workshop aimed at discussing legislative strategies centered on the pledges of the June 3 local elections, with the Democratic Party adopting “livelihood, economy, and growth” as its slogan. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (정청래 전 대표와 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원은 이날 서울 용산구 한 호텔에서 열린 더불어민주당 국회의원 워크숍에 참석했다. 자리는 국회 상임위원회별로 배정됐으나, 이들은 한병도 원내대표와 한성숙 국무총리, 강훈식 대통령비서실장 등과 함께 ‘지도부 테이블’에 나란히 자리했다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Kim Min-jeon: "Since When Was 'Let's Go to Starbucks' Hate Speech? It's Because of Lee Jae-myung's Divisiveness" (국힘 김민전 “‘스벅 가자’ 언제부터 혐오 언어였나…이재명 갈라치기 때문”)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon said, "Since when did 'Let's go to Starbucks' become hate speech?" and claimed, "If President Lee Jae-myung hadn't set up divisive frames ahead of the election, such a problem would never have occurred." (김민전 국민의힘 의원이 “‘스타벅스 가자’가 언제부터 혐오의 언어였나”라며 “이재명 대통령이 선거를 앞두고 갈라치기 프레임을 걸지 않았다면 이런 문제는 발생하지도 않았을 것”이라고 주장했다.)

During the People Power Party's floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 3rd, Rep. Kim stated, "The harm caused by a divisive leader is making future generations suffer," adding, "Excessive disciplinary actions affecting athletes' careers and sending funeral wreaths to schools—excessive psychological violence—are planting seeds of greater conflict and hatred in future generations." (3일 국회에서 열린 국민의힘 원내대책회의에서 김 의원은 “분열의 지도자가 끼치는 해악이 우리 미래 세대를 고통스럽게 하고 있는 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 김 의원은 “선수 생명에 영향을 주는 과도한 징계, 학교에 근조 화환을 보내는 과도한 심리적인 폭력은 더 큰 갈등과 혐오의 씨앗을 미래 세대에 심는 것”이라고도 했다.)

Rep. Kim also criticized Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin for describing the "Starbucks cheer" on the 1st as "denigrating the May 18 Democratization Movement and regional disparagement," saying, "He too easily labeled the immature cheers of Baejae High School students as regional hatred." He added, "Rather than prescribing strengthened history and human rights education, siding with the collective malice in some parts of our society that demands ending athletes' careers for being 'unqualified' is also inappropriate for an educator." (김 의원은 또 최교진 교육부 장관이 지난 1일 ‘스타벅스 응원’을 “5·18 민주화운동 폄하 및 지역 비하”라고 표현한 데 대해 “배재고 학생들의 철없는 응원을 너무 쉽게 지역 혐오로 규정”했다고 비판했다. 이어 “역사와 인권 교육의 강화를 처방으로 내놓는 것이 아니라, 선수로서 자격 미달이라며 선수생명을 끊어야 한다는 우리 사회 일각의 집단 패악에 장단 맞추는 것도 교육자로서 부적절하다”고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Park Sang-woong urged the Korea Baseball Softball Association to "immediately withdraw the six-month ban from national competitions, which lacks foundation and fairness," regarding the disciplinary action against Baejae High School's baseball team. In the same meeting, Rep. Park argued, "This is practically a death sentence for the baseball lives of student athletes" and "Punishing even players who did not directly participate in the chant is closer to collective punishment than education." (박상웅 국민의힘 의원은 배재고 야구부가 대한야구소프트볼협회로부터 ‘전국대회 6개월 출전정지’ 징계를 받은 것을 두고 “근거와 형평성을 잃은 전국 대회 6개월 출전 정지 처분을 즉각 철회하길 바란다”고 촉구했다. 박 의원은 이날 같은 회의에서 “학생 선수들의 야구 인생에 내린 사실상의 사형 선고와 다름없다”며 “직접 구호에 참여하지 않은 선수들까지 처벌하는 것은 교육이 아니라 집단적 연좌제에 가깝다”고 주장했다.)

The People Power Party views the six-month competition ban decided on the 1st as excessive. Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said on Facebook that day, "Not all Baejae High School players committed wrongdoing, and many players did not join the mockery, so a six-month ban for the entire team is excessive." People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won also said on Facebook, "They took away the freedom to go to Starbucks, and now they're stealing the children's dreams too." (국민의힘은 지난 1일 결정된 ‘6개월 출전정지’ 징계가 지나치다고 보고 있다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 같은 날 페이스북에서 “배재고 선수 전체가 잘못을 저지른 것도 아니고, 조롱에 동조하지 않은 선수들도 많이 있는데 배재고 야구부 전체에 6개월 출전정지 징계는 과도하다”고 했다. 나경원 국민의힘 의원도 페이스북을 통해 “스타벅스 가는 자유도 뺏더니, 아이들 꿈마저 빼앗나”라고 했다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon calls the resumption of disciplinary action by the People Power Party "bizarre… They're fighting me to prolong the ruling faction's survival" (한동훈, 국힘 징계 재개에 “괴기스럽다…당권파 연명 위해 나랑 싸워”)

He added, "Looking at the members of the Ethics Committee and the Audit Committee, I think, 'What kind of people are these?'" The PPP's Ethics Committee is set to hold a plenary meeting around the 6th to resume discussions on disciplinary actions that were suspended during the June 3 local elections. Now, the keywords for the Democratic Party regime are the legitimacy debate and the withdrawal of the indictment. This is an extremely anachronistic form of politics." <<> Regarding the Democratic Party taking back the chairmanship of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, Han said, "They want to use both existing power and powerless power? That's how power collapses," adding, "When we come to power and become the majority party, I will give the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to the opposition party. That's the right thing for the country." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (한 의원은 3일 부산일보 유튜브 ‘뉴스캐라’에 출연해 “(당권파가) 위기를 모면하기 위해, 연명하기 위해서 자꾸 저랑 싸우는 그림을 만들어 비빌 언덕을 만들려는 것”이라며 “윤리위, (당무)감사위원장 면면을 봐도 뭐 저런 (사람들인가) 이렇게 생각이 든다”고 말했다. 국민의힘 윤리위는 오는 6일께 전체회의를 열어 6·3 지방선거 기간 중단했던 징계 논의를 재개한다. 선거 기간 한 의원을 지원한 친한계 의원들을 겨냥한 징계요청서가 수십건 쌓인 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Lee Un-ju: "They Carved Up Committee Chair Posts, Excluding Only Me... Is This Political Retaliation?" (이언주 “상임위원장, 나만 쏙 빼고 나눠먹기…정치보복인가”)
item.description:
Lee Un-ju, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized the party’s floor leadership over the selection of standing committee chairs for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, stating, "They finished carving up the committee chair positions, leaving me out completely—someone who has never once held a chairmanship. She added, "There are people serving their second or third term as committee chairs, so I asked what the rational reason was, what connection their expertise had to state affairs, and what the criteria were, but I got no answer." <<> Lee continued, "In this day and age, where do you find such an irrational organization?" and "This isn't a position for personal gain or for a clique to benefit their group. Lee had left the Democratic Party in 2017 and rejoined in 2024. <<> "I came back determined to put an end to the atmosphere of ridiculing others, snickering, bullying, and playing favorites like a school clique, and to stop the unproductive, lowly political arena that spreads falsehoods, demonizes opponents, and competes through negativity," Lee said. After all, am I not the leading figure of the 'New Lee Jae-myung,' representing moderates and conservatives in the Democratic Party? Many awakening party members say I was right and stand with me, and that gives me great comfort and hope." <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa: freehwa@hani.co.kr (이언주 더불어민주당 의원이 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원장 선출을 두고 민주당 원내 지도부를 향해 “위원장을 한번도 안 한 나를 쏙 빼고 상임위원장 나눠먹기를 끝냈다”며 “정치 보복인가”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "4,755 Trillion Won for Three Mega-Projects, Flood of Questions Only Natural… The Scale Must Grow" (김용범 “3대 메가에 4755조, 쏟아지는 의문 당연…스케일 커져야”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, chief of the presidential office's policy planning, stated, "In the era of a production revolution, it's not just the scale of production that grows; the scale of the state's thinking must also grow along with it." (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 “생산혁명의 시대에는 생산의 스케일만 커지는 것이 아니다”라며 “국가가 생각하는 스케일도 함께 커져야 한다”고 말했다.)

In a post titled "The Korean Economy, Its Scale Has Changed" uploaded to Facebook late on the night of the 2nd, Director Kim said, "Artificial intelligence (AI) is not merely a technological revolution but a production revolution, and this production revolution is changing both South Korea's industrial structure and the grammar of its macroeconomy." (김 실장은 지난 2일 밤 페이스북에 올린 ‘한국경제, 스케일이 달라졌다’는 제목의 글에서 “인공지능(AI)은 단순한 기술혁명이 아니라 생산혁명, 그 생산혁명이 대한민국의 산업구조와 거시경제의 문법을 함께 바꾸고 있다”고 했다.)

Referring to the government's 'Three Mega-Projects' (semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI) announced on the 29th of last month, Director Kim commented, "A total of 4,755 trillion won. 800 trillion won for semiconductors, 573 trillion won for AI data centers. When numbers rarely seen in the Korean economy emerged, questions like 'Is this really possible?' and 'Isn't this a hastily put-together event?' poured in," adding, "It's a natural reaction." He went on to write, "What the AI revolution creates is not simply corporate performance. It's more production. The state's task now is where and how to channel that surplus." (김 실장은 지난달 29일 정부가 발표한 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’(반도체·에이아이 데이터센터·피지컬 에이아이)를 언급하며 “총 4755조원. 반도체 800조원, 에이아이 데이터센터 573조원. 한국경제에서는 좀처럼 보기 어려운 숫자들이 등장하자 ‘정말 가능한가’, ‘급조된 이벤트 아니냐’는 질문이 쏟아졌다”며 “당연한 반응”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “인공지능 혁명이 만들어내는 것은 단순한 기업 실적이 아니다. 더 많은 생산”이라며 “이제 국가의 과제는 그 잉여를 어디로, 어떻게 흘려보낼 것인가다”고 썼다.)

Director Kim emphasized the supply of electricity and water to support semiconductor production. "Building power plants, connecting transmission grids, securing water resources, and creating industrial complexes are ultimately all matters of consensus," he said. "Now is the time we must not miss that opportunity." He added, "The order cannot be changed. Let's build the fabs. Let's release the power and water. Greater production creates a greater surplus, and that surplus becomes the resource for better distribution." (김 실장은 반도체 생산을 뒷받침하기 위한 전력·용수 공급을 강조했다. 김 실장은 “발전소를 짓고, 송전망을 연결하고, 용수를 확보하고, 산업단지를 조성하는 일은 결국 모두 합의의 문제”라며 “지금은 그 기회를 놓쳐서는 안 된다”고 말했다. 이어 “순서는 바뀔 수 없다. 팹을 짓자. 전력과 용수를 풀자”며 “더 큰 생산이 더 큰 잉여를 만들고, 그 잉여가 더 나은 분배의 재원이 된다”고 했다.)

Relevant ministers also provided support by stating that new nuclear power plant construction could be considered. Minister of Climate, Energy, and Environment Kim Seong-hwan appeared on MBC Radio that day and said, "(If semiconductor factories increase), it's truly no small matter. Since semiconductors require a stable 24-hour electricity supply and handling it with just the increasing amount of renewable energy is no small feat, we need to quickly review whether we should build additional nuclear power plants." (관련 부처 장관들도 신규 원자력 건설을 검토할 수 있다고 지원사격에 나섰다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관은 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오에 출연해 “(반도체 공장이 늘어나면) 정말 만만치 않다”며 “반도체는 24시간 전기를 안정적으로 공급해야 하는데 재생에너지의 늘어나는 양만으로 감당하기가 만만치 않기 때문에 그러면 원전을 좀 더 추가로 지어야 될지 여부에 대해 빨리 검토해봐야 된다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "It Will Be the Starting Point for Advanced Industries in Yeongnam"... Hanwha, Hyundai Motor, and Others Plan 312 Trillion Won Investment (이 대통령 “영남 첨단산업 출발점이 될 것”…한화·현대차 등 312조원 투자 계획)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 3rd, "'Yeongnam, the cradle of South Korea's industries,' will now be reborn as the 'birthplace of South Korea's super-gap advanced industries.'" (이재명 대통령이 3일 “‘대한민국 산업의 산실’ 영남이 이제 대한민국 ‘초격차 첨단산업의 태동지’로 거듭나게 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

In a congratulatory speech at the "National Report on the Vision for Advanced Industrial Development in the Yeongnam Region" held in Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province, President Lee stated, "Today's national report will be the starting point to establish Yeongnam as a solid 'super-gap leading region' for advanced industries in South Korea." He emphasized, "If we integrate advanced technologies and industries such as physical AI and aerospace on top of Yeongnam's solid manufacturing foundation, which built the industrial framework under harsh conditions, South Korea will lead the future global market." ( 이 대통령은 이날 경남 진주에서 열린 ‘영남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’ 축사에서 “오늘 국민보고회는 영남을 대한민국의 확고한 첨단산업 ‘초격차 선도 지역’으로 세우는 출발점이 될 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “척박한 조건 속에서도 산업의 기틀을 세워 올린 영남의 탄탄한 제조 기반 위에 피지컬 에이아이(AI), 우주항공 등 첨단 기술과 산업을 융합한다면, 대한민국은 미래 글로벌 시장을 선도하게 될 것”이라고 강조했다.)

This event followed the "National Report on the Three Major Mega Projects for South Korea's Great Leap Forward" held on the 29th of last month, with a total investment of 312 trillion won in the Yeongnam region. Hanwha Group will invest about 55 trillion won in satellites and launch vehicles, while Hyundai Motor Group will invest about 42 trillion won in AI-based autonomous driving mobility. Samsung plans to invest about 60 trillion won to build a humanoid robot mass production line and a next-generation battery mass production line. SK Group will invest about 14 trillion won to build a 2-gigawatt (GW) AI data center. ( 이날 행사는 지난달 29일 개최된 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회’ 후속 행사로, 영남권에는 총 312조원의 투자가 이뤄진다. 한화그룹은 위성, 발사체 등에 약 55조원을 현대자동차그룹은 에이아이 기반 자율주행 모빌리티 등에 약 42조원을 투자한다. 삼성은 약 60조원을 투자해 휴머노이트 로봇 양산 라인, 차세대 배터리 양산 라인 등을 구축할 게획이다. 에스케이(SK)그룹은 약 14조원을 투자해 2기가와트(GW)급 에이아이 데이터센터를 구축할 예정이다.)

President Lee said, "Yeongnam is the undisputed top manufacturing hub in South Korea and has the potential to leap into a global advanced manufacturing hub," adding, "Large-scale investments to foster advanced industries will be added on top of this solid foundation." He continued, "Along with large-scale investments in next-generation semiconductors and AI data centers, we will intensively foster the largest robotics innovation belt in the country, as well as physical AI fields including automobiles and the world's top shipbuilding industry, remodeling manufacturing sites into intelligent industries." ( 이 대통령은 “영남은 명실상부한 대한민국 제조업 1위 거점이자, 글로벌 첨단 제조업 거점으로 도약할 잠재력을 가지고 있다”며 “이 탄탄한 기반 위에 첨단산업 육성을 위한 대규모 투자가 더해진다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “차세대 반도체와 에이아이 데이터센터에 대한 대규모 투자와 함께 국내 최대 로봇산업 혁신 벨트와 자동차, 세계 1위 조선 등을 포함한 피지컬 에이아이 분야를 집중 육성하여 제조 현장을 지능형 산업으로 다시 빚어낼 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

He also emphasized the full-scale construction of the "South Coast Aerospace Industry Belt." President Lee stated, "Aerospace is a new growth engine industry that Yeongnam will cultivate for South Korea," and "The government plans to fully build the South Coast Aerospace Industry Belt, connecting satellites, launch vehicles, future aircraft, and new space industries." He added, "The government will respond to the bold moves of companies that have decided on large-scale investments by mobilizing all national capabilities. To this end, I, as president, will personally monitor and take special care of this. The central government will pursue bold package support combining tax, fiscal, financial, regulatory, and infrastructure elements." ( 그러면서 ‘남해안 우주항공 산업 벨트’를 본격 구축하겠다고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “우주항공은 영남이 키워낼 대한민국의 새로운 먹을거리 산업”이라며 “정부는 위성과 발사체, 미래 항공기와 우주 신산업을 연결하는 남해안 우주항공 산업 벨트를 본격 구축할 예정”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “정부는 대규모 투자를 결단한 기업의 통 큰 행보에 국가적 역량을 총동원하여 화답하겠다”며 “이를 위해 대통령인 제가 직접 세심히 살피고 각별히 챙기겠다. 중앙 정부는 세제와 재정, 금융과 규제, 인프라를 한데 묶은 과감한 패키지 지원을 추진할 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
